title: Convert to Symbol menu item does nothing
description: User report: Insert/Modify > Convert to Symbol does nothing (0053 symbol-instances marked done, 0101 fixed menu dispatch, so actions now fire). Trace the path: MenuBar onConvertToSymbol prop -> does Shell pass a handler? -> does the handler require a selection and silently no-op without one (Flash 8 shows the Convert to Symbol dialog whenever something is selected; greys the item out otherwise)? Expected Flash 8 behavior: with a selection, F8/menu opens the Convert to Symbol dialog (name, behavior MovieClip/Button/Graphic, registration point grid), replaces the selection with an instance of the new symbol and adds it to the Library. Verify with the 0095 bridge: draw, select, convert, assert library + instance in document. See docs/07-symbols-instances-library.md.
